input.quote: This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or employee-inducement covenant binding the Company. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel" and "employ" return no restrictive personnel covenant, and a full read of the operative sections confirms it: the only restrictive covenants are the mutual exclusivity provisions in Section 6 (product/site exclusivity in 6.1 and HDI's two-year competing-project restriction in 6.3), and Section 5.4 merely provides for each Party to appoint a General Manager as liaison. The entire-agreement clause (10.7) confirms no personnel covenant is imported from elsewhere. This meets the preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no redline is required. Note that Section 6.3's post-term restriction runs only against HDI and therefore benefits us; it is not flagged.
